liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (5 reviews): Here Comes Sunshine leads into a unique jam; Here Comes Sunshine goes into a rare jam through space, the only one of its kind [6][9][11][12][13]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds Donna's singing painful, especially on Greatest Story Ever Told; Jerry's jam in Greatest Story Ever Told is loved [12][13][16]
- **Brown-Eyed Women** (1 review): Brown-Eyed Women stands out for its sweetness [6]
- **Wave That Flag** (1 review): Wave That Flag is described as lots of fun [13]
- **Big River** (1 review): Big River is singled out as good [12]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Jack Straw is called incredible [6]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review): Playing in the Band is long, typical of the era [11]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): The last five or six minutes of Eyes of the World are intense [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Bobby's Spider Rap**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **Weather Report prelude**: rare: 4 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd73-04-02.sbd.miller.17346.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 34 songs; 216 min; rated 4.47/5 by 30 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls it a crisp, well-mixed soundboard where early sound problems are quickly worked out [16]
- **gd73-04-02.sbd.ashley-bertha.22246.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 34 songs; 216 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says this copy sounds better than the other circulating option for the date; sound, mix and performance get four stars; The band sounds in sync and the Wall of Sound comes across well; Reviewer finds instruments and vocals clearer on the original source than on this remaster [8][9][10]
- **gd1973-04-02.sbd.hamilton.00169.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 35 songs; 208 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [5]. Said about its sound: Mix problems affect Promised Land, and Deal has some distortion; Brief dropouts occur in Greatest Story at 2:39 and Here Comes Sunshine at 11:46 [5]
- **gd1973-04-02.sbd.yerys.00170.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 35 songs; 208 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [3]

## Around the show

- Eyes of the World is competent but not the most impressive of the spring tour [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-04-02.sbd.miller.17346.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd73-04-02.sbd.ashley-bertha.22246.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1973-04-02.sbd.hamilton.00169.sbeok.shnf**: source: MSR > Cassette > DAT [5]. Also: Early show is crisp, clear and lower generation; from Me and My Uncle on it is higher generation with more bass [5]
- **gd1973-04-02.sbd.yerys.00170.sbeok.shnf**: source: mSR > cassette > DAT > CDR [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - Dave's Picks Vol 21: 1973-04-02 Boston Garden, Boston, MA (2017)](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2017/01/grateful-dead-daves-picks-vol-21-1973.html) [19]
- Poster by Shakin' Street: [The Grateful Dead – Shake’s Picks 4: Boston Garden, Boston, 4/2/1973](https://shakinstreetblog.wordpress.com/2015/04/29/the-grateful-dead-shakes-picks-4-boston-garden-boston-421973/) [20]
